basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer based in Austin, Texas. I've always had a passion for sports, especially baseball, which I play in a local amateur league. I enjoy spending my weekends watching games or organizing fantasy leagues with my friends. I'm single and enjoy exploring new music and comedy shows. My usual online hours are late evenings after work when I unwind by catching up on Reddit and planning my next fantasy league.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 10 years. My love for sports has led me to learn a lot about fantasy leagues, mostly through trial and error and discussions with friends. I also enjoy music and comedy, which I often explore through my top subreddits.
